newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice falls as grains and oilseeds collapse.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice falls as grains and oilseeds collapse.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended lower on Tuesday, hit by a massive sell-off in grains and oilseeds, pit sources said.
"Other markets hit the skids and we just went with them," one trader said. "We're just in the seasonal doldrums."
Traders said locals were long the May contract going into the midday expiration, pushing that contract lower in very thin trade.
Commercials were light buyers of both old and new crop.
Technical traders pegged $11.28 to $11.35 per cwt as support areas for the July.
Rice ended 14 to three cents per cwt lower with July off nine at $11.37. Volume was estimated by CBOT at 200 lots, compared with Monday's actual volume of 104 lots.
